answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 60454 Country: India Title: Dua for Shoulder pain Question: What is the dua for remedy of shoulder pain? Answer ID: 60454 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1230/1222/L=10/1436) Read out the following verse seven times and blow on some oil and apply it on the place of pain, in-shaAllah, it shall relieve you. وَبِالْحَقِّ أَنزَلْنَاهُ وَبِالْحَقِّ نَزَلَ وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلاَّ مُبَشِّراً وَنَذِيراً [الإسراء : 105] Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
